registered_before: any LID-DS 2021 official recording or any 2019 holdout recording is cached or scored with the chosen system
owner_decision: 18/11: after the development study (23 single changes, 90 combinations, rate branch; only lidds-ml-v5 passed the registered must-rules), the owner chose to relax the LID-DS 2021 development rule by one detection and test the result
seen_before_registration: every development result in validation-evidence/results-20261118/lidds2019-development (study.json, grid.json, rate.json, latency.json); the rule below is written knowing them. The holdout was scored by lidds-ml-v5 in lidds2019-confirmation-v2 (pooled and per-scenario results known)

changed_rule.was: LID-DS 2021 development: detected >= 530/544, false-alarm recordings <= 6, p95 <= 1.52 s (token-design-study-v1 KEEP)
changed_rule.now: LID-DS 2021 development: detected >= 529/544, false-alarm recordings <= 6, p95 <= 1.60 s; CB-DS unchanged (>= 891, <= 3)

added_rule: n = 4 only: the probe counts 4-grams in the kernel map key, so a longer gram needs a new probe; candidates with n = 5 are out
selection: the registered order on the grid of grid.json: most 2019 development detections (1 s tolerance), then fewer 2019 development false-alarm recordings, then lower p95, under 2019 development false-alarm recordings <= 1 %

chosen.name: lidds-ml-v5-t3 (candidate; lidds-ml-v5 stays the system until the steps below and a live run)

steps: LID-DS 2021 official: the base spec must first reproduce lidds-ml-v5 official (1,238/1,271, 26/7,938, p95 1.47 s) through this code path; then the chosen system once, reported beside lidds-ml-v5

2019 holdout (841 attack, 5,395 normal): the base spec must first reproduce the registered lidds-ml-v5 decisions on the holdout recordings; then the chosen system once (output written once), primary rule and 1 s tolerance, pooled and per scenario, C1
cluster: top-k, trim and alpha are worker-side; a refit and a live run are needed before the chosen system is claimed on the cluster
reporting: the registered lidds2019-confirmation-v2 result stays the primary LID-DS 2019 result; this amendment, its post-hoc rule change and the holdout having been scored by lidds-ml-v5 are stated with the result
